description:
Home screen widget showing random photos from your Nextcloud Shows a random picture from a folder on your Nextcloud server as a home screen widget, without syncing your photo library to the phone. Only one downscaled preview is stored at a time. Features
  • Random photo from one or more Nextcloud folders, subfolders included
  • Picture changes automatically every 15 minutes to 24 hours, or only on tap
  • Configurable photo list refresh, with photo count, last sync time and sync duration
  • Tap the left edge for the previous picture, the right edge for the next one
  • Tap the center to open the picture in the official Nextcloud app
  • Light, dark or system theme
Privacy The app only talks to the Nextcloud server you configure. Login uses Nextcloud Login Flow v2, so a revocable app password is stored on the device and never your real password. There is no tracking and no analytics. Requires Android 8.0 or newer and a Nextcloud server reachable over HTTPS. This is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with Nextcloud GmbH.
